general_local_4plus2_cosmological_form.flrw_horizontal_metric: g_munu dx^mu dx^nu=-n(t,y)^2 dt^2+a(t,y)^2 q_ab^(k) dx^a dx^b
general_local_4plus2_cosmological_form.isotropy_restriction: N^i_a=0; possible N^i_t is a normal-bundle shift/twist and is not set to zero globally by H3
general_local_4plus2_cosmological_form.local_section_gauge: At a chosen observed 4D section and event one may use an orthonormal Gaussian-normal frame with N^i_mu=0 and gamma_ij=delta_ij locally; this is a local frame statement, not a global gauge claim.

exact_local_parent_to_extrinsic_bridge.convention: K^i_munu=(1/2) L_{n_i} g_munu in the local orthonormal Gaussian-normal frame
exact_local_parent_to_extrinsic_bridge.meaning: B_squared is not an independent fluid parameter at this level; it is the squared normal gradient of the logarithmic 4D scale factor induced by the 6D metric.

mixed_parent_equation_and_codazzi_source.geometric_role: The normal-tangent 6D Einstein equations are the parent equations behind the H2 Codazzi source S_i.
mixed_parent_equation_and_codazzi_source.mixed_ricci: R_i0=M6^(-4) T_i0 when G_i0=0 in the local section frame; Lambda6 and the trace term do not contribute to the mixed component.
mixed_parent_equation_and_codazzi_source.scalar_flux: T_i0^(phi)=n_i(phi)*u(phi) in the local orthonormal frame
mixed_parent_equation_and_codazzi_source.gauge_flux: T_i0^(F)=Z_F F_iP F_0^P in the local section frame
mixed_parent_equation_and_codazzi_source.source_free_sufficient_condition: T_i0=0 together with the mixed Einstein equation implies vanishing mixed ambient Ricci source for Codazzi; it is not imposed as a universal M1 identity.
mixed_parent_equation_and_codazzi_source.important_nonimplication: A purely magnetic static internal profile has no mixed matter flux, but a genuinely time-dependent scalar/gauge/internal geometry can source T_i0 and therefore S_i.

factorized_warp_test.result_B_squared: B_squared=|grad_perp A|^2, time independent when the internal geometry and normal frame are time independent
factorized_warp_test.consequence: Merely replacing the static maximally symmetric 4D metric of the frozen M1 specialization by an FLRW metric while keeping the internal warp static cannot generate the B_m^2 a^(-3) term.

minimal_axisymmetric_fixed_section_test.subsector: chi-independent diagonal internal metric with observed 4D section at fixed (r,chi), no gravitational normal shift/twist
minimal_axisymmetric_fixed_section_test.target_requirement: The exact D2N-Q profile B_Lambda^2+B_m^2*a^(-3) without an a^(-3/2) cross term requires two orthogonal nonzero normal components when both B_Lambda and B_m are nonzero.
minimal_axisymmetric_fixed_section_test.rank_one_square: If beta is confined to one normal direction and beta=B_Lambda+B_m*a^(-3/2), then B_squared contains 2*B_Lambda*B_m*a^(-3/2), which is absent from the target profile.
minimal_axisymmetric_fixed_section_test.scope: This is an ansatz-level no-go, not a falsification of the full 6D M1 parent theory or of all possible codimension-two embeddings.

requirements_for_full_d2nq_realisation.governance: Any extension must remain inside the one-time signature and be derived from the canonical parent metric degrees of freedom; adding an independent embedding action would be a separately governed branch.

parent_equations_needed: tangent-tangent Einstein evolution and Hamiltonian sector
normal-bundle Ricci equation and global patch consistency
reconstruction_outputs: B_Lambda and B_m if dynamically identifiable
